image_description: A single roll of white toilet paper mounted on a wall-mounted holder. The holder appears to be made of metal with a wooden backplate or surrounding wood paneling. The toilet paper roll has a visible embossed texture and a cardboard core. The lighting creates shadows on the left side of the roll.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly a cylindrical roll of paper. The winding structure is visible on the side face.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Roll is compact with modest diameter and width, suitable for standard bathroom holder.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Proportions appear consistent with a standard commercial toilet paper roll relative to the holder hardware.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Individual sheets perforated for easy tearing.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct grid-like or quilted embossed pattern is clearly visible on the outer surface of the roll.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cardboard core visible at center of roll.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The inner hole reveals the edge of the cardboard tube/core.
The paper is white/off-white, consistent with the class definition.

Similar to the geometry checkpoint, specific perforation holes are not resolvable in this image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Household paper product in roll format.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Contextual cues (holder, wall) confirm it is a household product in roll format.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight blurring and softness at the boundary between the paper roll and the white holder rod, lacking crisp edge definition typical of real photography.
